statements.status_notes: Upgrading @tootallnate/once in plugin directories triggers puppeteer postinstall hooks that fail in the build environment. Waiting for upstream OpenSearch Dashboards plugins to update their dependency.

Upgrading @tootallnate/once in plugin directories triggers puppeteer postinstall hooks that fail in the build environment. Waiting for upstream OpenSearch Dashboards plugins to update their dependency.

Fix requires @tootallnate/once 3.0.1 or newer; the hoisted 2.x instance cannot be bumped across a semver-major boundary without unacceptable risk for this image line. Waiting for upstream to move the dependency tree to 3.x or an alternative fix.
